opening.title: Ledger in ninety seconds
opening.subtitle: Find an entry, open it, read it
opening.disclaimer: A bundled fixture application. No real data appears in this video.
opening.narration: This is Ledger, a small example application that ships with Rushes so a first run has something to film.

scenes.narration: The overview opens on three counters and the entry table underneath. Everything on this screen is a real page in a real browser, not a drawing of one.
Typing into the filter narrows the table as you go. The recording drives the real input with a human cadence, so what you see is what a person would see.
Clicking a row opens its detail panel. The scene declares what must be on screen when it ends, so a video of a page that never changed cannot be delivered.

closing.title: That is the whole loop
closing.subtitle: Storyboard, record, check, deliver
closing.narration: Every step resolved, every scene showed what the voice claimed, and the checker measured the finished file before anything was delivered.
